verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides velocity/authorization controls, card-state transitions (to block a card) and a dispute-case API for Mastercard, which cover parts of the fraud/dispute lifecycle, but there is no documented network fraud score, ops-facing suspicious-activity alerting, or explicit reissue workflow. missing for 10: fraud score surfaced at authorization time, suspicious-activity alert tooling, explicit compromised-card reissue flow.
